capstone.title: Your First Photo Portfolio
capstone.brief: Build a portfolio of ten photos: two portraits, two landscapes, two product or food photos, two event or street photos, and two free-choice photos. Edit them lightly and present them as a set.
checks: Two product or food photos included
Two event or street photos included
Photos saved in one portfolio folder
deliverables: A short caption for each photo
A note on your favorite style
A plan for your next photo project
